literal_meaning: হাড় পোড়ানো বা জ্বালানো (burning the bones)
figurative_meaning_bn: অত্যন্ত উত্ত্যক্ত বিরক্ত বা নির্যাতন করে এমন
example_sentences_in_english: His talk is really bone-tormenting to listen to.
He torments me every day with his behavior.
note: This idiom vividly expresses intense frustration using the imagery of physical pain to bones, common in everyday Bengali discourse.
